snippet.title: Night Witches: Nazis Couldn't Catch a 70 mph Plane
snippet.description:
How do you catch a plane that's too slow to catch? In WW2 the Luftwaffe flew some of the fastest fighters of the war, and yet the Soviet "Night Witches" kept slipping away from them in wood-and-canvas crop dusters.

The 588th Night Bomber Regiment was a whole regiment of young women, most of them around twenty. They flew the Polikarpov Po-2, a 1928 trainer also used for crop dusting, at night and eight or more times a night. Near the target they throttled back and glided in, so the camp below heard little more than the wind in the bracing wires. They flew without parachutes until 1944. The Germans called them the Nachthexen: the Night Witches.

Why were they so hard to shoot down? A Po-2 cruised at about 70 mph (110 km/h), below the stall speed of a Bf 109 or an Fw 190, fighters built for well over 350 mph (600 km/h). A fighter that slowed down to stay behind one risked falling out of the sky, and one that didn't shot straight past before its pilot could aim. They were not untouchable: on one night in the summer of 1943 a German night-fighter pilot shot down several of them. By the end of the war the regiment had flown about 23,000 sorties and dropped more than 3,000 tons of bombs.

The ace, the camp and the fuel trucks in this Short are dramatized; the regiment, the plane and the trick are real.

Sources: Wikipedia, "Night Witches"; Irina Rakobolskaya & Natalia Kravtsova (2005); Anne Noggle, "A Dance with Death" (1994); Military Aviation Museum, Polikarpov Po-2.

Some love stories may come to an end, but the memories can stay with us forever. “Storm In My Heart” by Rockin’ Jukebox Records captures that feeling through the nostalgic sound of vintage 1960s-inspired rock ’n’ roll.

Blending soulful male vocals, heartfelt guitar melodies, and carefully selected dance performances, this special video remix creates an emotional musical experience filled with romance, longing, and nostalgia.

For anyone who has ever loved deeply, lost someone special, or remembered a beautiful chapter of the past, this song is a reminder that certain feelings never completely disappear.

Multiple dance clips were carefully selected, edited, rearranged, and reconstructed into a new visual sequence that complements the rhythm and emotional mood of “Storm In My Heart.” The original scene order was changed, creating a fresh flow of dance performances that follow the music.

Animated lyrics, creative transitions, timing adjustments, and additional visual effects were incorporated throughout the edit. Through creative scene arrangements and synchronization with the song, the original footage was given a fresh presentation with added entertainment and visual value.

“Storm In My Heart” by Rockin’ Jukebox Records is an emotional love ballad inspired by the nostalgic sound of vintage 1960s rock ’n’ roll.

Featuring soulful male vocals, classic guitar melodies, and a timeless romantic atmosphere, the song explores lost love, heartbreak, longing, and memories of someone who once meant everything.

It brings to mind the kind of love that remains in your heart even after life takes two people in different directions. Because some memories never fade, no matter how much time passes.

snippet.title: 집순이의 집밥일기 #집밥 #vlog #shorts
snippet.description:
저번에 LA갈비로 김치찜을 만들어 먹었는데 너무 잘 어울리고 맛있어서 남은 LA갈비로 김치찜 만들었어요!

만드는 김에 LA갈비 남은 거 다 사용해야지 하고 만들었는데 너무 많이 만들었나 봐요 저 팬 저희 집에서 제일 큰 건데 작아서 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 당황😆
다 같이 요번 주 아침은 김치찜 당첨이에욬ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ

저는 항상 김치찜에 계란찜+돌김이랑 같이 먹는데 오늘은 날씨도 춥고 그래서 뜨근한 계란국 끓여줬어요👍
역시 겨울에는 뜨끈한 국물이 최고야..💛

오늘도 영상 보러 와주셔서 감사합니다!!
다들 맛저 하세요!💛🍀

오늘 만든 김치찜은 김치랑 고기 양이 어느 정도인지 모르겠어서 저번에 2인분 양 만들었던 레시피 적어 놓을게요!

✅LA갈비 김치찜 레시피
• 김치 반포기, LA갈비 4~5줄 물 650ml, 코인육수 3g 2개, 고춧가루 2T, 맛술 2T
설탕 0.5T, 된장 0.5T, 다진 마늘 1T, 미원 0.5T, 새우젓 0.3T, 후추 조금, LA갈비 양념 조금
(LA갈비 양념이 달지 않기도 하고 김치가 좀 많이 익어서 설탕 좀 넣어줬어요)
• 강불에서 한번 끓을 때까지 끓여주고 끓어오르면 중불로 바꿔서 30분 정도 뚜껑 닫고 끓여줍니다
• 30분 후 썰어둔 파, 청양고추를 넣고 15분 더 끓여주면 끝!

✅계란국 레시피
• 물 600ml, 국간장 1T, 멸치액젓 0.5T, 다시다 조금 넣고 끓여준 다음
• 물이 끓으면 계란 3개 풀어서 넣어주세요 (이때 숟가락으로 휘젓지 말기)
• 계란이 몽글몽글 올라오면 간을 본다음 싱거우면 다시다 추가해 넣어준 다음
• 파 넣고 조금 더 끓여주면 끝!
.
.
.

snippet.title: 「能動的サイバー防御」って、結局なんなのよ
snippet.description:

世界中のハッカーに気づかれ始めてる。。。 https://youtu.be/yV5J2DCoTfw
ハッカーホイホイ作ったら48時間で1万回来た https://youtu.be/a77m_WSa93A

▼X（生存確認用）
https://x.com/kaigai_ypapa

GMOインターネットグループが10月24日、能動的サイバー防御の「発動第1号」として国に無害化を要請しました。「日本もついに攻め返せる」という受け止め方が目立ちますが、法律を読むと中身はかなり違います。

警察が回線越しに入っていく先の多くは、攻撃者本人ではなく、乗っ取られて踏み台にされた誰かの家のルーターや防犯カメラです。ハッカーはそうした踏み台を何か国も渡り歩き、踏み台そのものも時間貸しで売られています。相手の機械が外国にあったとき、法律が何を決めていて何を決めていないのかも、条文と国会答弁から整理しました。

FBIの削除作戦、止めても戻ってきたVolt TyphoonやEmotet、実名と信用をさらして効いたLockBitの摘発、そして日本を「攻撃の縛りを解いた」と批判する中国。並べてみると、守る仕事は攻める仕事とまるで別物だと見えてきます。
